==Preparation==
{{See also|Treasure Trails/Guide/Emote clues/Items}}
[[Clue scroll (master)|Master clue scrolls]] can be between six and eight clues long, with multiple fights and puzzles, and can have very high-levelled quest and [[skill]] requirements. For each master clue step, there is an equal chance of rolling each category of step.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://x.com/JagexAsh/status/1791072390098657427|date=16 May 2024|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/27964587|archivedate=28 October 2026|quote=Category is rolled first, then clue within that category. For master clues, the categories have equal weighting regardless of how many clues exist for them; other tiers handle that differently.|group=p}} Once the step category is rolled, then there is an equal chance of rolling each step within that category. For a suggested inventory setup, see the [[Treasure Trails/Strategies#Setups | Setups page]].
